title: ProjectWorld Producer Descriptor
description: Owner-declared identity of one World producer or of the shared realization pipeline: id, version, output revision, declared data inputs, and implementing modules. A producer is keyed by generator_id plus generator_version and lives at Plugins/<Category>/<Plugin>/Data/Producers/<generator_id>.json in its owning plugin; the pipeline descriptor is Plugins/World/ProjectWorld/Data/Producers/realization_pipeline.json.

data_input.description: Repository-relative file whose bytes shape the producer's output and are not per-unit canonical input.

runtime_acceptance.description: Expectations product acceptance reads for this producer's output; the runtime acceptance parser owns the accepted values. Never part of producer identity.

output_revision.description: Bumped in the same change as any output change for unchanged inputs.

modules.description: Modules that implement this producer; used for proof routing, never for identity.

pipeline_revision.description: Bumped in the same change as any output change of the shared save, inventory, or capture path.

modules.description: Generic World modules; used for proof routing, never for identity.
